notes.general_comments: General comments Whilst there were some very pleasing scripts scoring high marks Examiners were disappointed to see quite a significant proportion of scripts scoring very low marks. Scripts in this category unfortunately showed little understanding of the topics examined. One other feature of this paper was the particularly poor performance on Question 1. Further comment on this question appears below. Comments on specific questions Most candidates gained little or no credit on this question.
